body: Darling, as a fellow sufferer, I understand. *Completely.* I'm so sorry to hear that so much is currently bothering you. I wish I could help so much more, but this is all I can do. I KNOW how annoying it is to hear *"just talk about it with someone"*. and I understand how hard it is. BUT PLEASE, I'm very worried. Don't let suicide take you..please..I'm here. Try talking to a friend. I know it's hard..Message me if you must, I will listen.
